title: Never Let an AI Agent Do THIS Automatically #shorts
description: An AI agent can draft, check, and propose — but high-impact actions need human approval. A fictional invoice example explains why wrong actions propagate across connected apps. Google's new Gemini work agent was announced Oct 8. #AIagents #Gemini #automation #shorts

captions.text: A wrong AI answer is bad. A wrong action is worse.
One invoice mistake can spread across apps.
Which action would you never auto-approve?

visual_note: ILLUSTRATIVE RECONSTRUCTION; not product recording; enterprise access and permissions vary.
